Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask and the draft MAP. I reviewed it and attached our proposed MAP spreadsheet with embedded milestones and owner assignments (redwood_map_with_rollout.xlsx). High level answers below:

- Proposed canary window: 2025-09-14 to 2025-09-18 (three business days of progressive traffic ramp; September 14 = day 0 smoke/run short tests, then 15–18 progressive traffic).
- Training cadence: 2 x 90-minute remote sessions the week of 2025-09-08 (Sept 10 and Sept 11) for SRE and product ops, plus an optional 60-minute runbook walk-through on Sept 12. We can provide recordings.
- Rollback criteria (top-level):
  - Sustained latency > 2x baseline for > 10 minutes on 95th percentile for API/stream endpoints.
  - Error rate spike: >1.5% 5xx for > 5 minutes.
  - Model regression alerts on quality checks (model sampling) where failure rate on critical prompts increases beyond threshold.
  - Manual sign-off from Novara SRE or Product Ops for production rollback.
- Owners: 
  - Primary Red wood tech owner (on-call during canary): Mateo Alvarez (me).
  - Escalation / CS coordination: Marissa Cole.
  - Deployment / infra ops: Laura Bennett.
  - Training delivery: Grace OConnor.

I've attached a short canary runbook excerpt (canary_runbook.md) and a proposed training schedule (training_schedule.xlsx). If those dates work, I'll loop in procurement contact and produce a final MAP for signature.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the canary window + training compression preference (full week vs condensed).
2) We lock owners and update the MAP doc.
3) We circulate runbook excerpt to procurement for their packet.

Cheers,

Mateo Alvarez
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: redwood_map_with_rollout.xlsx, canary_runbook.md, training_schedule.xlsx)

Elena —

We can compress training to the two 75-minute focused sessions you requested. Updated plan below (I'll publish an updated MAP spreadsheet after we lock procurement timelines):

Training (compressed):
- 2025-09-10 10:00–11:15 PT — SRE ops deep dive: monitoring, alerts, rollback controls, canary dashboard walkthrough.
- 2025-09-11 13:00–14:15 PT — Product Ops: model sampling, quality checks, functional fallbacks, incident playbook.
- Optional recorded runbook walkthrough delivered to the team within 24 hours after sessions.

Rollback criteria (automatic vs manual):
- Automatic rollback triggers:
  - Platform-level health: sustained connectivity errors across hosts causing >2% of requests failing at the load balancer for 5 continuous minutes.
  - Memory/leak detection: OOM or host instability detected by infra agents.
  - Model server runaway: token emission anomalies that breach safety thresholds configured in the model (we will provide example thresholds).
- Manual rollback (requires Novara SRE/Product Ops sign-off):
  - Latency degradations in the 95th percentile (between 2x–3x baseline) where the issue is isolated to Redwood but is intermittent and not meeting auto-rollback thresholds.
  - Quality regressions detected by sampling where human review flags >3 critical failures in a 100-sample batch.

Canary validation metrics (examples):
- 95th p50/p95 latency trends, error rate (4xx vs 5xx), model quality checks (sampled prompts + automated scoring), user-facing error telemetry, and token cost anomalies.

Action items (what we will do next):
- Mateo: update MAP spreadsheet with compressed training and publish final PDF. (Due: 2025-09-01)
- Marissa: prepare the procurement packet and acceptance checklist for Novara procurement. (Due: 2025-09-02)
- Laura: confirm deployment blackout windows and infra pre-checks. (Due: 2025-09-04)
- Grace: prepare training decks and recordings. (Due: 2025-09-08)

Elena — once you give procurement a green light on dates, we'll finalize and send the signature-ready MAP.

Regards,

Mateo Alvarez
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
